question: 单项选择：You have to study hard, _____ you want to pass the exam. A. if  B. unless  C. because  D. so
answer: 答案：A. if。解析：if引导条件状语从句，"如果"。must强调主观必要性，have to强调客观必要性。

question: 单项选择：I _____ go to school even on weekends when I was in that school. A. must  B. have to  C. had to  D. A and B
answer: 答案：C. had to。解析：when I was in that school是过去时间，用had to。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：You ______ (mustn't) park here. It's not allowed.
answer: 答案：mustn't。解析：mustn't表示禁止，"不许"。park"停车"。allowed"允许"。

question: 单项选择：You look tired. You _____ have a good rest. A. must  B. mustn't  C. have to  D. should
answer: 答案：A. must。解析：must表示建议，"应该/必须"。整句：You must have a good rest.

question: 翻译句子：must和have to都表示"必须"，有什么区别？
answer: 答案：must强调主观上的必要性，往往来自说话人本人的判断；have to强调客观上的必要性，往往由于外部条件、规则或情况而不得不做。

question: 单项选择：I have to work on weekends, _____ my job requires it. A. because  B. if  C. unless  D. but
answer: 答案：A. because。解析：because引导原因状语从句，"因为"。整句：I have to work on weekends because my job requires it.

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (had to) take care of her little sister last night.
answer: 答案：had to。解析：last night是过去时间。have to的过去式是had to。

question: 单项选择：You don't really _____ come if you're busy. A. must  B. have to  C. mustn't  D. A and B
answer: 答案：B. have to。解析：don't have to表示"不必"，暗示如果你忙可以不来。

question: 翻译句子：他不得不工作到很晚才能完成任务。
answer: 答案：He has to work late to finish the task. 解析：has to"不得不"。to finish表示目的。

question: 单项选择：I have to wake up early, _____ I have an important meeting. A. because  B. if  C. unless  D. but
answer: 答案：A. because。解析：because"因为"，解释不得不早起的原因。
